reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`service_name` label: Loki 3.0 will automatically assign a `service_name` label to all ingested logs by default", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: All ingested logs receive an automatic service_name label in Loki 3.0 by default, derived from configured source labels or set to unknown_service, which may affect existing downstream systems and query experiences that do not expect this label.

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0 automatically assigns a service_name label to all ingested logs by default, derived from a configurable list of existing labels or set to unknown_service if none are found.
